name: Copilot Content Block
title: Sales Performance Explorer
description: Interactive sales performance dashboard for 100 orders from January to August 2026. Filter chips for region, category and channel update six metric cards (revenue, profit, margin, orders, average order, units), a grouped bar chart of monthly revenue and profit with a margin-percent line, a top-products revenue bar list, and a salesperson leaderboard. Full dataset totals 2.77 crore revenue and 1.89 crore profit at about 68 percent margin.
